# Subway Seat for kitty

Colors, cursor, selection, borders, tab bar, title bar, scrollbar and marks. For light/dark following, copy the Enamel file to `light-theme.auto.conf` and a dark one to `dark-theme.auto.conf`.

[kitty](https://sw.kovidgoyal.net/kitty/) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/kitty/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.conf`](subway-seat.conf) | `~/.config/kitty/themes/subway-seat.conf` |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.conf`](subway-seat-tunnel.conf) | `~/.config/kitty/themes/subway-seat-tunnel.conf` |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.conf`](subway-seat-enamel.conf) | `~/.config/kitty/themes/subway-seat-enamel.conf` |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.config/kitty/kitty.conf:

```conf
include themes/subway-seat.conf
# or choose it interactively: kitten themes
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.config/kitty/kitty.conf:

```conf
include themes/subway-seat-tunnel.conf
# or choose it interactively: kitten themes
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.config/kitty/kitty.conf:

```conf
include themes/subway-seat-enamel.conf
# or choose it interactively: kitten themes
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.config/kitty/themes/subway-seat.conf`.
- Delete `~/.config/kitty/themes/subway-seat-tunnel.conf`.
- Delete `~/.config/kitty/themes/subway-seat-enamel.conf`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
